name: redact-launch-gate
command:
set -eu; test "$(cat VERSION)" = "1.0.0"; test "$(cat RUNTIME_VERSION)" = "2b3e07d398016e92008d8399e79c441e012dce38"; test -f LICENSE; test -f kennel.toml; test -f SECURITY.md; test -f docs/domain-signoff/checklist.md; test -f .github/workflows/verification.yml; grep -Fq 'export PRODUCT_VERSION := "1.0.0"' src/version.kujo; grep -Fq 'version = "1.0.0"' kujo.toml; grep -Fq 'version = "1.0.0"' kennel.toml; git diff --check; printf 'schemaVersion=redact-workcell-proof/v1
candidate_sha=%s
product_version=%s
kujo_runtime_commit=%s
network=none
human_domain_signoff=false
' "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" "$(cat VERSION)" "$(cat RUNTIME_VERSION)" > redact-workcell-proof.txt

commands.name: candidate-metadata
command: grep -Eq '^candidate_sha=[0-9a-f]{40}$' redact-workcell-proof.txt && grep -Fq 'product_version=1.0.0' redact-workcell-proof.txt && grep -Fq 'human_domain_signoff=false' redact-workcell-proof.txt
